summary: Affiliated Managers Group, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 30, 2026, reporting its second quarter and first half 2026 financial results via an earnings press release. The release also announced the Board authorized and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.01 per share of common stock, payable August 24, 2026 to stockholders of record on August 10, 2026. The filing includes items 2.02 (results of operations), 8.01 (other events), and 9.01 (exhibits). This is a routine quarterly earnings report with a regular dividend declaration, not a special situation.
